Plot one or more dimensionality reductions of an OlinkExperiment

Source: R/plot_dim_reduc.R
plot_dim_reduc.Rd

Creates a scatter plot of a low-dimensional representation of protein expression data (PCA, t-SNE, UMAP, ...) with points colored by a sample covariate. When several reductions are requested (e.g. type = c("pca", "umap")) they are plotted **jointly** as a combined multi-panel figure.

Usage

plot_dim_reduc(
  olinkobject,
  type = c("pca", "tsne", "umap"),
  color = NULL,
  label = NULL,
  ellipse = TRUE,
  ellipse_level = 0.95,
  title = NULL,
  scale = TRUE,
  center = TRUE,
  n_neighbors = 15,
  min_dist = 0.1,
  metric = "euclidean",
  perplexity = 30,
  seed = 42,
  assay_col = NULL,
  value_col = NULL,
  sample_col = NULL,
  ncol = NULL,
  palette = NULL,
  color_by = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

olinkobject

An OlinkExperiment object, or a data.frame in long format.

type

Character vector of dimensionality reductions to plot: one or more of "pca", "tsne", "umap", or any names stored in reducedDims() (matched case-insensitively). With several types the panels are combined into a single figure (via patchwork). Defaults to "pca".

color, color_by

Optional name of a sample covariate (a column of colData(olinkobject)) used to color the points.

label

Optional name of a sample covariate used to label the points.

ellipse

Logical; draw confidence ellipses around groups (default TRUE).

ellipse_level

Confidence level for the ellipses (default 0.95).

title

Overall plot title. For a single panel this replaces the default per-panel title; for a joint figure it becomes the combined figure title (default NULL).

scale

Logical; scale variables to unit variance before PCA (default TRUE).

center

Logical; center variables before PCA (default TRUE).

n_neighbors

Number of neighbors for UMAP (default 15).

min_dist

Minimum distance between embedded UMAP points (default 0.1).

metric

Distance metric for UMAP (default "euclidean").

perplexity

Perplexity for t-SNE (default 30).

seed

Random seed for reproducibility (default 42).

assay_col, value_col, sample_col

Optional column names (long-format input only). If NULL, they are auto-detected from common names.

ncol

Number of columns when several reductions are combined into a joint figure (default NULL, i.e. auto).

palette

Optional color palette for groups; uses olinkviz_palette() if NULL.

...

Additional arguments passed to ggplot2::geom_point().

Value

A ggplot object (single type) or a patchwork combined figure (several types).

Details

If a requested reduction is already stored in reducedDims(olinkobject) (matched case-insensitively, e.g. type = "pca" matches a stored "PCA"), the stored coordinates are used. Otherwise the reduction is computed on the fly:

  • "pca": principal component analysis via stats::prcomp().

  • "umap": UMAP via the umap package.

  • "tsne": t-SNE via the Rtsne package (optional dependency; install with install.packages("Rtsne")).

Any other type must match the (case-insensitive) name of an existing entry in reducedDimNames(olinkobject).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
oe <- oe_from_long(iris_longcovid)
plot_dim_reduc(oe, type = "pca", color = "long_covid")

# plot several reductions jointly
plot_dim_reduc(oe, type = c("pca", "umap", "tsne"), color = "long_covid")

# plot a reduction stored in reducedDims(oe)
reducedDim(oe, "UMAP") <- matrix(rnorm(ncol(oe) * 2), ncol = 2,
  dimnames = list(colnames(oe), c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")))
plot_dim_reduc(oe, type = "umap", color = "long_covid")
} # }
